comparison_candidates.name: MScompress
comparison_candidates.core_idea: Multi-threaded mzML to MSZ compressor with random-access decode support and configurable lossless or lossy encoding.
comparison_candidates.why_it_matters: It is a modern practical systems baseline with explicit focus on speed, threading, and usable compressed-file access.

comparison_candidates.name: MS-Numpress in mzML
comparison_candidates.core_idea: Array-level compression inside the mzML ecosystem: linear prediction for smooth m/z arrays and logged or integer schemes for intensities.
comparison_candidates.why_it_matters: It is the closest standard-adjacent baseline for testing whether mzarc beats established PSI-compatible spectrum array compression.

comparison_candidates.name: mzMLb
comparison_candidates.core_idea: Keeps standards-compliant mzML metadata while moving bulk numeric arrays into HDF5 for better speed and storage efficiency.
comparison_candidates.why_it_matters: It is a direct standard-preserving answer to the same problem mzarc is addressing: less storage and faster access without giving up open-format interoperability.
